description: Rank local repo files and return bounded contiguous implementation and test evidence. Hard limit: max_files <= 20. Multi-layer traces default to accuracy depth; simple lookups stay compact. Use only as a targeted follow-up. Do not iteratively broaden retrieval within a case; after this result, synthesize or request another distinct missing file within the five-follow-up task budget. For oversized files use prompt path:start-end ranges; combine consecutive ranges without treating an individual range as a complete body. Files include line_count.
name: rank_relevant_files
